HOME.HERO_TITLE: School enrollment and fees, made simple.
HOME.HERO_LEAD: SchoolGate connects schools and parents: place requests, application review, Mobile Money payment and invoices, on a single platform.
HOME.HIGHLIGHT_1_TEXT: They find a school, request a place and follow their application from their phone.
HOME.HIGHLIGHT_2_TEXT: Enrollment fees and tuition installments paid without queuing at a counter.
HOME.HIGHLIGHT_3_TEXT: Every validated payment produces an invoice whose authenticity can be checked online.
HOME.STEP_1_TEXT: It creates its account, then sets up its classes, seats and fees.
HOME.STEP_2_TEXT: From the app, they find the right school and submit their application.
HOME.STEP_3_TEXT: It accepts or declines each request within the deadline it has set.
HOME.STEP_4_TEXT: The parent pays with Mobile Money; the school validates and a verifiable invoice is issued.
HOME.SCHOOL_BENEFIT_1: Every enrollment request in one place
HOME.SCHOOL_BENEFIT_2: Seats and class fill rates tracked in real time
HOME.SCHOOL_BENEFIT_4: Several staff members, each with their own rights
HOME.PARENT_BENEFIT_1: Find a school by city, level and system
HOME.PARENT_BENEFIT_4: Pay securely and keep every invoice

PARENT.FAQ_Q1: How do I request a place for my child?
PARENT.FAQ_A1: Open "Schools", choose a school and a class, then "Request a place". Enter the child (with their sex), whether they are a returning or new student, and add the documents asked for.
PARENT.FAQ_A2: Each school sets its own list: it is shown on its page and in your request. Accepted formats: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB max. You can add documents later from the enrollment.
PARENT.FAQ_A3: Once the request is accepted, open the enrollment and choose "Pay". Pick MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money, enter the paying number and confirm the request received on the phone with your PIN.
PARENT.FAQ_A4: The service fee is shown before each payment, on top of the amount owed to the school.
PARENT.FAQ_A5: Every validated payment produces a verifiable invoice, available in the enrollment detail.
